high_level_description: The image shows a black T-shirt with a graphic design printed on the front. The design features a stylized cannabis leaf in gold, which is crowned by an ornate crown. Above the crown, there is a small, intricate cross-like symbol. The T-shirt has short sleeves and a crew neck. The brand name "PRDGY" is visible at the top of the shirt, just below the neckline. The mood of the image is somewhat regal and edgy, combining elements of luxury (the crown) with a rebellious or alternative theme (the cannabis leaf). The gold color of the design contrasts sharply with the black fabric
